Dumps gossip tile contact info and socket addresses from shared state.

# Purpose
This C file defines the `gossip-dump` action for the application command framework. The main function, [`gossip_dump_cmd_fn`](<#gossip_dump_cmd_fn>), reads the current topology from `config->topo`, finds the `gossip` tile, and joins the tile workspace in read-only mode. It then gets the `fd_gossip_tile_ctx_t` context and reads the tile `my_contact_info` data with a volatile copy to avoid direct concurrent access.

The command prints the local contact information for the gossip tile to standard output. It formats and prints the node public key in Base58, the shred version, and each configured socket address and port that is set. The file ends by registering the action in `fd_action_gossip_dump`, which exposes the command name, handler function, and a short description for use by the wider command system.
